claim_scope: Development-only discrete-conformer estimate of the AM1-BCC/OBC-II/ACE hydration correction after reweighting the frozen CREST conformer set with MACE-OFF23 medium gas-phase single-point relative energies. This forward-default comparison uses the same states and MLIP checkpoint as the historical ABCG2 diagnostic. It is not a basin-integrated conformational free energy, an RRHO treatment, a lambda-path calculation, or confirmation evidence.

model.name: maceoff23m
model.role: Gas-phase intramolecular single-point relative energies used only as discrete conformer Boltzmann weights; the absolute MLIP energy zero cancels.

limitations: The discrete state library is the union of the frozen CREST/GFN2-xTB/ALPB(water) set and the original FreeSolv geometry, not a gas-phase MACE sample.
MACE energies are single points on xTB geometries; no MACE geometry relaxation is included.
CREST geometric deduplication does not supply basin volumes, vibrational free energies, or symmetry degeneracies.
The estimator is a discrete-minima diagnostic and must not be labeled a converged finite-temperature hydration free energy.
Fixed AM1-BCC charges, OBC-II radii, and ACE nonpolar physics remain unchanged.
next_gate: Compare AM1-BCC and historical ABCG2 on the identical frozen states, then proceed to AM1-BCC gas/solution relaxation only if the charge change does not erase the MLIP conformer signal.
